personality_one_liner: An industrial, high-contrast, indestructible utility tool built for gloved hands and bright factory floors.

spacing.rule: Industrial spacing. Use thick structural borders and zero radius. Touch targets must be massive (min 56px height) for gloved hands.

dont's: Never use glass. Brutalist apps require solid, opaque surfaces and hard lines.

screens.name: Nowa (Home)
screens.purpose: Primary entry point to start a new wall calculation either via camera scan or manual entry.

states.loading: Centered monospace text 'ŁADOWANIE...' with a hard-edged progress bar.
states.empty: No recent scans - show 'BRAK HISTORII' in big text.
states.error: Red error box with sharp corners and 'BŁĄD' message.

screens.layout: Top section: Industrial Header 'DOCINKI PRO'. Middle section: Massive full-width primary CTA 'SKANUJ RYSUNEK' (Scan Drawing) with a huge camera icon (brandPrimary background, onBrandPrimary text, 2pt border). Below it: 'WPROWADŹ RĘCZNIE' (Manual Entry) as a secondary outline button. Bottom section: Quick list of 2-3 recent calculations. All cards and buttons have 2pt solid borders and 0 radius.

screens.name: Skaner (Scanner AI)
screens.purpose: Take a photo of the architect's drawing for Gemini 3 Flash to process.

states.loading: Full screen 'ANALIZA AI TRWA...' (AI Analysis in progress) with a flashing block animation.
states.error: Error reading dimensions -> Fallback to manual entry.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera view. Overlay a targeting frame (aspect ratio of A4 paper). Bottom panel: Solid black surfaceInverse container with a massive white Shutter button. Text instructions overlay: 'WYKADRUJ CAŁY RYSUNEK' (Frame the entire drawing).

screens.name: Wynik (Wall Detail / Cut List)
screens.purpose: Displays the calculated cuts ('docinki') per course based on the AI analysis or manual input, allowing edits.

states.error: Calculation error -> show red warning banner.

screens.layout: Sticky primary CTA at bottom ('ZAPISZ' - Save). Top: Wall ID and overall dimensions (e.g., 'ŚCIANA F1-14402 | 320x301 cm') in huge SpaceGrotesk type. Middle: Tabular, row-by-row cut list grouped by course (Warstwa 1, 2, 3...). Rows use monospace font for measurements. Right side of each row shows the cut dimension in bold. Include a summary block ('Zestawienie cięć') grouping same-length cuts to minimize saw setup time.

screens.name: Historia (History)
screens.purpose: List of previously saved walls and their cut lists.
screens.layout: Standard list view but brutalist. Each row is a thick-bordered rectangle. Row layout: Left side Wall ID, Right side Date. Subtext: dimensions. Touch targets are large (min 64px height).

screens.name: Ustawienia (Settings)
screens.purpose: Configure default block sizes, bond type, tolerance, and clearance (luz) for the factory floor.

states.error: Validation error on inputs (e.g., invalid size).

screens.layout: Single-column form. Labels above inputs in uppercase monospace. Inputs are massive rectangular boxes (surfaceSecondary with 2pt border). Fields: Domyślny Blok (Default 50x25 cm), Tolerancja (Tolerance, e.g. 98cm instead of 100), Luz (Clearance, e.g. -1cm), Min. wielkość docinki (Min cut size). Sticky 'ZAPISZ USTAWIENIA' button at the bottom.

blueprint_empty_state.alt: Blueprint schematic drawing of a brick wall layout

factory_header_backdrop.alt: Industrial factory construction site with cranes and clay bricks

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Brutalist Mobile LIGHT personality. This is a tool for factory workers wearing gloves.
Use 2pt solid borders on buttons, cards, and inputs. ZERO border radius everywhere.
Typography: Use SpaceGrotesk-Bold for headers/labels and SpaceMono-Regular for all data, measurements, and inputs to create a technical, precise feel.
Navigation: 3 Bottom Tabs -> Nowa, Historia, Ustawienia.
Screen 'Nowa' must emphasize the 'Skanuj Rysunek' (Scan) action with a huge touch target.
Screen 'Wynik' must structure cuts course-by-course (Warstwa) clearly, making it easy to read on a dusty/bright factory floor.
Implement the Settings page with the precise variables requested: Block size (default 50x25), Tolerance, and 'Luz' (Clearance).
Integrate a mock or real Gemini API call on the Scanner screen to parse the image, but gracefully fallback to a manual dimension editor if it fails.
Ensure all interactive touch targets are AT LEAST 56px high, preferably 64px, to accommodate gloved hands.
Do NOT use glassmorphism, blur, or subtle shadows. Everything should be flat, high-contrast, and strictly structural.
